No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Kidnapping: Kaduna Police Seek Residents’ Support To Prevent Attacks by Nonye Ekwenugo 7 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Residents of Maraban Rido and other communities in Kaduna State have been urged to work closely with the police to prevent kidnapping and other criminal activities.
The Commissioner of Police, Muhammad Rabiu, made the appeal during a security patrol covering the Eastern Bypass, Rido Village, Maraban Rido, Unguwan Luka and Izam community in Igabi local government area of the state.
At Maraban Rido, the CP met with the traditional ruler and residents, who presented their complaints and security concerns to the police team.
He urged residents, traditional rulers, community leaders and youth groups to report suspicious persons and movements promptly, stressing that community support was essential to preventing attacks.
The commissioner assured residents that information provided to the police would be treated confidentially and acted upon professionally.
He added that timely intelligence from residents would help the police respond swiftly to security threats and prevent criminal attacks.
The patrol also took the police team to Unguwan Luka and Izam community, where they assessed security concerns as part of efforts to strengthen relations between the police and residents.
